body:
Finite bit-circuit construction; **no new kappa**. On the frozen PR952 word, repeating its same six-wire Gaussian menu with the unchanged two local growth guards finds zero replacements. Admitting those nominees by their actual complete-word precision bounds instead permits **42 replacements**, saving **240 further ADDs** including literal cleanup: **23,673 → 23,433**, or **872 fewer than selected PR589**. Only `research/r439-global-prefix-admission/` is added.

Every new replacement fails at least one old local entrywise guard. The final complete bounds nevertheless improve to **F = 35,655, B = 692,438**, requiring **91 local bits and 172 nine-stage bits** within the inherited 104/192 ceilings. All original H1-H5, 439 helpers, nine copies, per-register frame paths and paid rank mass 5,129 are preserved. D, B, scatter and other payload fields remain byte-for-payload equal to PR952; C is rebuilt literally.

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.10+, C++17 and Boost headers:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-global-prefix-admission/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R439_GLOBAL_PREFIX_ADMISSION: 42 blocks; 240 further ADDs; 872 versus PR589; H1-H5; 104/192-bit caps; 5/9/11 stages; no new kappa`. `BOOST_INCLUDE` selects a nonstandard header directory. The default command regenerates both comparisons and runs all native checks.

Validation completed:

- Same Gaussian nomination domain in both comparisons: 60 blocks, 720 pivot orders, two modes and the two inherited donor priorities; **172,800 nominations per comparison**. A single seed-3 block order, at most 32 sorted shorter nominees per block, first admission then stop. All 42 first nominees pass; zero actual budget rejections. No optimum or unrestricted fixed-point claim.
- Independent checks of **2,688 local Boolean inputs and 504 positive column pairs**. Literal ADD/COPY/ERASE and set-valued all-661-column replay of every accumulated trial in both directions: **1,979,296 instructions**, with every complete price matching the builder's separate macro evaluator.
- Unchanged source geometry/H1-H5 and fresh native legality/5/9/11 stages for PR589, PR952 and the candidate: **883/1,327/1,549 formal columns per word, 144 bridge controls**. Sixteen local controls include a Boolean-correct word that needs 103 local bits but 194 nine-stage bits, proving the second cap is exercised independently.
- Full receipts are identical on CPython 3.14.4 and an isolated optimized **read-only minimal closure under CPython 3.12.3**. Seven artifact tests, all 18 exact source-object pins, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace pass. Hosted CI is separate; no full `make verify` or selected complex cold replay is claimed.

**Credit and limits:** the inherited 632 savings are PR904's 254, Ross Richardson's PR936's 340, and PR952's 38. The new 240 are separate. zeusinsight's PR857 and Jerry Chen's PR906 already use full precision checks despite local reverse growth; no priority for that general admission idea is claimed. Ross Richardson's PR925 has a 12-ADD frame-267 factor, shorter than this menu's 13-ADD nominee. PR941/965 and Sricharan Vagvala's PR967 change D under a different interface; Cinna Davis's PR973 changes B. None is composed here. Attribution for Jeffrey Cox, Sagar Thakrar, DreamingOfClouds, eumemic and the native-checker lineage is retained in NOTICE.md, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance disclosed.

The remaining adoption steps are full hosted emission/audit, global invoice and supplier binding, and outer assembly. Inherited all-size/compiler, realization, common-label/mutable-source, hosting, precision/tape/recovery and analytic obligations remain. The paid recursive profile and selected frontier are unchanged.

OS assignment seed **3**, bit track. Exact research base **946293a3dcaa9121ef5f4be44db2e07adb7de085**; parent PR952 **11d24706f06e95271804c9438869546724c67aab**. Refreshed main **bbc600db2fc15007b7c914f4f2b2ed55fa909c87** consumes identical runtime sources and selects PR942 with PR589 bits. Exact certificates, source pins, proof, negative controls and portable receipt are included. Apache-2.0; one AI agent, no independent human or subagent review.
title: Finite bit construction: full-prefix admission saves 240 R439 ADDs (no new kappa)
